header.title: New trading bot (StrategyRouter)
header.subtitle: Exchange, market type and execution mode are modeled separately — no cross-market misrouting

hints.spot: ℹ️ Spot market: no shorting, no leverage or reduce-only; you can only buy spot and sell existing holdings.
hints.futures: ℹ️ USDT-margined futures: long/short opening and closing with configurable leverage. The account's position mode (Hedge / One-way) is detected automatically, and native conditional stop-loss/take-profit orders are attached only for the actually filled quantity.
hints.marginAccount: The symbol's margin mode on the exchange account is left unchanged. Before opening a position, the symbol's leverage is set to the leverage in the strategy proposal.
hints.marginSet: Before opening a position, the symbol's margin mode is switched to {{mode}} and its leverage is set to the leverage in the strategy proposal. If the symbol already has a position or open orders on the exchange, the margin mode cannot be changed; that order is blocked and the reason is shown on the audit page.
hints.marginLocalSim: Local simulation does not use margin modes, so this option is unavailable.
hints.marginUnsupported: {{exchange}} does not support setting the margin mode yet; the exchange account setting is kept.
